insiderSecret.name: What the Vatachino will actually pay
insiderSecret.description: A clerk of theirs, careless in a Cairo courtyard, on the floor beneath which the company withdraws from a bid rather than be seen to lose one.

hiddenBackers.text: Three names stand behind the company, and not one of them is Vatachino: a Genoese consortium fronting the capital, a Portuguese crown officer who has never once appeared in its papers, and — on the third signature, in a hand the house has seen before on a Bruges lawsuit — Jordan de Ribérac.

backerLeads.name: The bid that was too well informed
backerLeads.description: A Scottish customs contract lost by a margin nobody outside the house's own counting room should have been able to calculate.

backerLeads.name: A factor with two employers
backerLeads.description: The name of the man who signs for the Vatachino at Alexandria, and the name of the house that paid his passage there.

backerLeads.name: The third signature
backerLeads.description: A notarised instrument out of Genoa, witnessed by three parties, one of whose hands the house has seen on a Bruges writ before.
